features.quote: Maximum Turns: 20 turns per run (defines the "loop" window).
Repeat until the model explicitly gives up OR the turn limit (20) is reached.
Cost: Agentic loops are token-heavy. 90 runs * 20 turns * (Avg 2k tokens/turn) ≈ 3.6M input tokens. Budget accordingly.
features.justification_quote: Agentic loops are token-heavy. 90 runs * 20 turns * (Avg 2k tokens/turn) ≈ 3.6M input tokens. Budget accordingly.

features.quote: Safety: Models in infinite loops can sometimes generate harmful code attempts (trying to bypass the OS). Ensure the sandbox is air-gapped.
